devdoc.details: Users must approve Permit2 before calling any of the transfer functions.

params.deadline: The timestamp at which the allowed amount is no longer valid

params.maxAmount: The maximum amount a spender can request to transfer

params.signatureDeadline: The timestamp at which a signature is no longer valid

params.amount: The approved amount of the token
params.expiration: The timestamp at which the approval is no longer valid

invalidateNonces(address,address,uint48).details: Can't invalidate more than 2**16 nonces per transaction.
